description: eugr's (Eugene Rakhmatulin) spark-vllm-docker recipes qwen3.8-flash-next-nvfp4-solo and -cluster, which now serve NVIDIA's Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP4-Local (ModelOpt mixed FP4 checkpoint of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, NVIDIA Open Model Agreement, informational; checkpoint revision b9ce18a6, about 102 GB of weights; this replaces local-inference-lab's Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4 that upstream served before) on a single Spark. Runs eugr's published vllm-node-b12x image (--exp-b12x lane, nightly-20261102, digest pinned, built from spark-vllm-docker b7f6b4cd) with upstream's launch: the b12x kernel stack (b12x model loader, linear, MoE and gated-delta-net decode kernels, modelopt_mixed quantization, bfloat16 dtype, FP8 KV cache, block size 16, mamba cache mode align), MTP with four speculative tokens, chunked prefill, prefix caching, qwen3 reasoning and qwen3_xml tool parsing, multimodal encoder tensor-parallel mode data, FlashInfer autotune off, act-quant fusion compilation pass, 262,144-token context and 4,096 batched tokens (upstream defaults), plus upstream's environment for the b12x stack (A16 MoE FP4 path with A4 prefill, MXFP8 LM head, w13 layer input scale). This is upstream's solo recipe (solo-only): upstream sets VLLM_PLE_TABLE_MEMORY=disk with B12X_DISK_BACKEND=io_uring, but io_uring is blocked by the sandbox seccomp profile and direct GDS has no real nvidia-fs, so the PLE table is held in host-shared RAM instead (VLLM_PLE_TABLE_MEMORY=shared, no disk backend; hardware failure 2026-11-01 cuFile error 5027); upstream's PYTORCH_ALLOC_CONF per_process_memory_fraction:0.8 bounds the CUDA reservation during A16 weight preparation, eight sequences and memory utilisation 0.905. Deviation from upstream (0.8), forced by moving the PLE table (about 28.8 GB) into the vLLM budget: at 0.8 the budget cannot hold the weights plus the table, so 0.905 (the single-Spark admission maximum) is used, estimated from the weights, the table, the margin the platform holds beside the budget and one full-context request; it is an estimate with no hardware evidence yet, replaced by the first measured run. Upstream's disk offload left the budget to KV cache (its changelog claims more than 1M tokens of KV cache); with the table in shared RAM the KV pool is smaller, so fewer concurrent long contexts fit than upstream. No upstream performance claims are recorded. Upstream repository MIT. Physical Spark acceptance is pending. GB10 memory: peak = 0.905 × 130,663,231,488 + 6.2e9 single-Spark vLLM margin held beside the budget (2 GiB host floor); an estimate, not a measured footprint, replaced by the first measured run.
title: Qwen3.8 Flash Next FP4-Local b12x vLLM single Spark (eugr)
